title: Simulation 3D Probabilistic Radar
text: 3D 仿真环境中的概率雷达传感器模型；输出 1 路；按 {Mounting location} 指定传感器安装位置；{Sensor identifier} 指定唯一传感器标识符、{Parent name} 指定父车辆名称 Scene、{Specify offset} 指定相对于安装位置的偏移、{Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)} 指定相对于安装位置的平移偏移量、{Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} 指定相对于安装位置的旋转偏移量、{Sample time} 指定采样时间、{Azimuthal resolution of radar (deg)} 指定雷达方位角分辨率、{Elevation resolution of radar (deg)} 指定雷达仰角分辨率、{Range resolution of radar (m)} 指定雷达距离分辨率、{Range rate resolution of radar (m/s)} 指定雷达的距离变化率分辨率、{Fractional azimuthal bias component} 指定方位角偏差比例、{Fractional elevation bias component} 指定仰角偏差比例、{Fractional range bias component} 指定距离偏差比例、{Fractional range rate bias component} 指定距离变化率偏差比例、{Field of view (deg)} 指定视场、{Detection ranges (m)} 指定检测距离、{Range rates (m/s)} 指定最小和最大检测距离变化率、{Detection probability} 指定雷达检测到目标的概率、{False alarm rate} 指定虚警率 1e-6、{Detection probability range (m):} 指定给定检测概率下的参考距离、{Reference radar cross section (dBsm)} 指定给定检测概率下的参考雷达截面积、{Enable elevation angle measurements} 启用雷达测量仰角、{Enable range rate measurements} 启用雷达测量距离变化率、{Enable measurement noise} 启用向雷达传感器测量添加噪声、{Enable false detections} 启用报告雷达虚警检测、{Random number generator method} 指定随机数生成器种子的方法、{Initial seed} 指定随机数生成器种子、{Maximum reported} 指定报告的最大检测数、{Coordinate system} 指定报告的检测的坐标系 Ego、{Specify output bus name} 输出总线名称、{Output bus name} 输出总线名称 BusSimulation3DRada，按实例取值。

ports.name: Detections
ports.summary: 目标检测 Simulink bus containing MATLAB ® structure

params.name: Sensor identifier
params.values: 唯一传感器标识符 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Parent name
params.values: 父车辆名称 Scene Origin (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: 传感器安装位置 Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center |...

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: 指定相对于安装位置的偏移 off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: 相对于安装位置的平移偏移量 [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: 相对于安装位置的旋转偏移量 [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Sample time
params.values: 采样时间 -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Azimuthal resolution of radar (deg)
params.values: 雷达方位角分辨率 4 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Elevation resolution of radar (deg)
params.values: 雷达仰角分辨率 5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Range resolution of radar (m)
params.values: 雷达距离分辨率 2.5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Range rate resolution of radar (m/s)
params.values: 雷达的距离变化率分辨率 0.5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Fractional azimuthal bias component
params.values: 方位角偏差比例 0.1 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Fractional elevation bias component
params.values: 仰角偏差比例 0.1 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Fractional range bias component
params.values: 距离偏差比例 0.05 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Fractional range rate bias component
params.values: 距离变化率偏差比例 0.05 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Field of view (deg)
params.values: 视场 [20, 5] (default) | positive real-valued 1-by-2 vector

params.name: Detection ranges (m)
params.values: 检测距离 [1, 150] (default) | positive real-valued 1-by-2 vector

params.name: Range rates (m/s)
params.values: 最小和最大检测距离变化率 [-100, 100] (default) | real-valued 1-by-2 vector

params.name: Detection probability
params.values: 雷达检测到目标的概率 0.9 (default) | real scalar in the range (0, 1]

params.name: False alarm rate
params.values: 虚警率 1e-6 (default) | positive real scalar in range [10 –7, 10 –3 ]

params.name: Detection probability range (m):
params.values: 给定检测概率下的参考距离 100 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Reference radar cross section (dBsm)
params.values: 给定检测概率下的参考雷达截面积 0 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Enable elevation angle measurements
params.values: 启用雷达测量仰角 on (default) | off

params.name: Enable range rate measurements
params.values: 启用雷达测量距离变化率 on (default) | off

params.name: Enable measurement noise
params.values: 启用向雷达传感器测量添加噪声 on (default) | off

params.name: Enable false detections
params.values: 启用报告雷达虚警检测 on (default) | off

params.name: Random number generator method
params.values: 设置随机数生成器种子的方法 Repeatable (default) | Specify seed | Not repeatable

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: 随机数生成器种子 0 (default) | scalar in range [0, 2 32 )

params.name: Maximum reported
params.values: 报告的最大检测数 50 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Coordinate system
params.values: 报告的检测的坐标系 Ego Cartesian (default) | Sensor Cartesian | Sensor spherical

params.name: Specify output bus name
params.values: 指定输出总线名称 off (default) | on

params.name: Output bus name
params.values: 输出总线名称 BusSimulation3DRadarTruthSensor (default) | valid bus name
